data.narrative:
Vital Lyfe is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Jonathan Criss and Andrew Harner that has raised $24M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, alongside 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $24M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $60M. This reflects the typical step-up from Seed to the next financing stage within the sector. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of 3+ datapoints after filtering for stage and valuation tier, making sector-wide medians inappropriately broad.

The triangulated valuation range is $51M–$69M, with a median of $60M. This narrow one-method analysis reflects genuine data scarcity rather than confidence. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for Vital Lyfe's specific market position and competitive trajectory, and the absence of direct peer benchmarking to validate the implied step-up rate. Additional financials or operating metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
